decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core upholstery textiles, supported by its own R&D and broad design capabilities, this product fits existing knowledge well and its dedicated web presentation suggests enough strategic importance to retain it.

This decorative fabric is close to the established offer and therefore learnable and improvable within the firm's absorptive capacity, though the lighter website presence implies a slightly higher chance of pruning than the most emphasized products.

Because it combines a familiar curtain fabric base with functional flame-retardant performance, the firm can exploit strong related knowledge and R&D to refine it, and the dedicated page points to commitment.

The product builds directly on the firm's decoration fabric competence and suits its quality and design positioning, so management would usually keep it unless early commercial response proved clearly weak.

Although somewhat more niche in material and construction, it still builds on the firm's established decorative textile know-how, making retention likely given the firm's R&D base and innovation-oriented market context.
